text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync after the postmortem — we saw a cross-vendor cascade: CDN auth edge started returning 5xx for refresh endpoints which triggered auth provider rate-limits, causing mass token refreshes and then model-registry leader flaps under write pressure. Need a concise mitigation plan with named owners and short deadlines.
Ben Torres: Yikes. I can take the immediate registry protection work: short circuit for heavy writes, reject large batches with a clear 429 and a retry-after header. Will also add a local write-backlog metric. ETA: 48h.
Elena Varga: I'll own auth-side mitigations: add client-side token-staggering (randomized refresh windows), and a small local token staler (+25s) so short provider blips don't force refresh storms. ETA: 36h.
Rui Santos: I'll drive vendor engagement and ask CDN + auth provider for correlated request logs and any edge-side throttling they've done. Will request a formal RCA and a short-term config tweak to smooth refreshes. ETA: vendor outreach by Wed.
Maya Patel: Thank you. Observability asks: split auth.refresh.fail_rate by CDN edge region, add registry.write.leader_stall_count, and a dashboard that overlays CDN 5xx spikes with auth refresh bursts. Who picks this up?
Ben Torres: I'll add the registry metrics and a p95/p99 alert for write latency.
Elena Varga: I'll add the auth metrics and an alert: auth.refresh.fail_rate > 1.5% for 10m -> page infra. Also will add a synthetic that does a full token-exchange + tiny registry write every 15m.
infra-bot: Created ticket INC-4120: "cross-vendor-auth-registry-cascade-mitigation". Link: https://issues.redwood/INC-4120
Maya Patel: Runbook short-form (add to runbooks/incident-playbooks):
```
- If auth.refresh.fail_rate > 1.5% for 10m -> page infra oncall
- Infra oncall: enable local-token-stale (+25s) and turn on client refresh-stagger (config toggle)
- If registry.write.leader_stall_count > 1 within 10m -> demote leader to read-only and route writes to secondary (manual for now)
- Open vendor ticket and request correlated CDN/auth logs; escalate to vendor SRE lead if not responded in 2 business hours
```
Rui Santos: Vendor ticket VND-8102 opened; asked for slices for the 3 incident windows, requested any CDN edge config changes and whether they applied per-IP limits. Scheduled a joint debug Thurs 14:00 PT.
Ben Torres: PR for registry soft-fail + 429s: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pull/1401 (WIP). Adds metric registry.write.rejected_batch_count.
Elena Varga: Synthetic and client stagger patch: https://git.internal/redwood/auth-client/pull/688. Deploying to smoke harness now.
Maya Patel: Ownership summary:
- Registry soft-fail + leader protections: Ben (owner)
- Client stagger + token staler + synthetic: Elena (owner)
- Vendor engagement & logs: Rui (owner)
- Incident tracking & follow-up: Ops (infra-bot)
Maya Patel: Timelines: client stagger + staler 36h, registry soft-fail 48h, alerts + synthetic 72h, vendor debug Thurs. We'll run the synthetic for 7 days and then reassess recurrence patterns and long-term fixes (regional active-passive registry, token mirror). Anyone blocked?
Ben Torres: CI flakes on a k8s job, might need an infra hand to repro. Pinged @infra for help.
Elena Varga: Deploying synthetic now; will post the runbook diff once it's in docs.
Rui Santos: Vendor acknowledged ticket, asked for our request list. Joint debug scheduled.
Maya Patel: Great. After we confirm 7 successful days of synthetic stability and a vendor RCA, we'll prioritize long-term architecture (regional replication + provider-side smoothing agreements). For now, paste PR links and runbook diffs here. :eyes:
